newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia noon rubber down on absence of demand.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia noon rubber down on absence of demand.

text.p: Malaysian rubber prices were down at midday on an absence of demand and weaker futures in Tokyo, traders said.
At midday, the Malaysian Rubber Exchange and Licensing Board quoted June RSS One buyer at 272.50 cents ($1.09) a kg, down three cents from Tuesday's close.
June SMR 20 buyer was down one cent at 256.50.
Traders offered the SMR CV at 331 cents, SMR L at 309, SMR 5 at 268, SMR 10 at 254 and drum latex at 226 cents.
"There's no demand as yet and Tokyo is down," said a trader.
Traders said supply of raw materials was still ample, although rains in recent days have reduced the flow of latex into the market.
